direction: Use the visible stock side/rear clearance as a proportional reference at 128 pixels per tile. Keep exposed windowed walls inside the plot, with a small visible gap on every side. Do not force side or rear walls to the boundary. Preserve useful entrance and service space. Exposed facades may have windows; avoid excessive empty paving or planted perimeter borders.
stock_spacing: Visible garden/yard at sides and front; building occupies only part of the plot. Do not enlarge it across the usable yard.
